translations.web: Then he sweeps by like the wind, and goes on. He is indeed guilty, whose strength is his god.”
translations.bsb: Then they sweep by like the wind and pass through. They are guilty; their own strength is their god.”
translations.kjv: Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.
translations.asv: Then shall he sweep by as a wind, and shall pass over, and be guilty, even he whose might is his god.
